text: Your team is talking. A bug needs fixing. But the answers are somewhere else.
Meet Chatty, the AI teammate that brings your project into the meeting. Just say her name.
Ask what changed. Chatty checks your GitHub repository and brings the relevant context, with sources, into the conversation.
Keep talking. Ask a follow-up. Turn the discussion into an issue, and shape the draft together.
Refine the draft. Check the details. Chatty gives you a short summary, then asks before taking action.
Say, sure, go ahead. Your decision becomes a GitHub issue, with a result you can verify.
When you're done, say, Chatty, stop. Okay. She stays quiet, and keeps listening.
Less searching. Less meeting admin. More momentum. Chatty. From conversation to action.
